applicant.name: Dr. Julia Brandstätter
applicant.organisation: European research consortium on ageing (Horizon Europe)

request.purpose: Scientific research on multimorbidity in older adults as part of a publicly funded research project.
request.question: What share of inpatient stays in 2024 had pneumonia as main diagnosis, per hospital?
definitions: Pneumonia stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with J18.
Count stays (not patients) whose start_date is in 2024.
Report per hospital: inpatient stays, pneumonia stays and the share of pneumonia stays in %, one decimal.
